Heat Stress Awareness — Summer Working Conditions

Key Points Covered

  • Signs and symptoms of heat exhaustion and heat stroke
  • Mandatory 15-minute rest breaks every 45 minutes during summer hours
  • Water intake requirements: minimum 250ml every 20 minutes
  • Buddy system: workers to monitor each other for symptoms
  • Emergency response: first aid station locations and contact numbers

Key Points Covered

  • No person to stand under a suspended load at any time
  • Exclusion zones: minimum 1.5x the lift radius must be clear
  • All lifting accessories (slings, shackles) must be tagged and inspected
  • Banksman / signaller must be certified and wear hi-vis vest
  • Crane pre-use checklist to be completed before each shift
